race.description: Apg Vicbred Super Series 4yo E&G Final Trot (G1)
race.comment: Two drawn on the back row look the standouts here so it could be luck in running that decides the winner. I AM HELLBOUND (12) found winning form in last week's heat at this circuit and distance, taking advantage of a good barrier to cruise home. He has been much less fortunate at the draw this time but is an accomplished trotter with nine wins this season up to Group 3 level so has the class to overcome the barrier. ALRIGHTY (10) has had an ideal preparation for this race, winning all four starts here since a spell. Another that led from a low draw to dominate in the heats but he overcame a similar barrier to this to score here prior. Big chance to do it again. IJUSTCALLEDTOSAY (13) has been racing well at this venue, placing in both outings since a win from this row. He can be competitive again. ALDEBARAN ABEL (3) returns to the front row after working last start and was racing consistently prior so include.
